arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Keisler argued the term award has a specific meaning in the Act.
Mr. Palmore argued the side that brought the case's interpretation makes the provision impossible to apply.
Mr. Gillelan stated Dana Roberts was injured in 2002 but awarded compensation in 2007.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Dana Roberts worked for Sea-Land Services. He became disabled in 2002. He received compensation in 2007. The parties disagree on the start date for benefits.
